'''Faris''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Theelin]] [[Jedi Initiate|Jedi youngling]], who came to be [[Jedi training|trained]] by the [[Jedi Order]] sometime before the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY]], he [[Death|perished]] at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] when the newly appointed [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] led an [[Operation: Knightfall|attack]] against the [[Jedi]]. By [[9 BBY]], his remains lay entombed at [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on the [[moon]] [[Nur]].

==Biography==
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> Faris<ref name="SDCC 2023">{{SW|url=news/sdcc-2023-lucasfilm-publishing-panel|text=SDCC 2023: 10 Reveals from the Lucasfilm Publishing Panel}}</ref> was among a group of five [[Jedi Initiate]]s—including [[Reva Sevander]]<ref name="Part V" />—that were led through a [[Jedi training|training]] routine by [[Jedi Master]] [[Minas Velti]] within the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]], when the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] executed [[Order 66]]—the command to [[Great Jedi Purge|eliminate]] the [[Jedi]]—under the authority of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. As part of [[Operation: Knightfall]], [[clone trooper]]s of the [[501st Legion]] interrupted Velti's training and opened fire upon the [[Clan (Jedi)|Jedi Initiate Clan]]. Velti defended [[Gender|herself]] and the younglings, striking the [[trooper]]s down in the process. She then led her younglings through the [[Jedi temple|Temple]], protecting them from troopers along the way. Velti was soon overwhelmed by [[Cloning|clone]] troopers and was [[Death|killed]] in combat.<ref name="Part I">{{Kenobi|Part I}}</ref>

Though Velti died in the escape, she protected the group of younglings, who were able to use her sacrifice to run.<ref name="Part I" /> However, Velti's death only delayed the inevitable as the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] found the younglings and slaughtered them all, except for Reva.<ref name="Part V" />

In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|IV}}</ref> Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] gained entry into a secure chamber in [[Fortress Inquisitorius]], where he discovered the remains of several fallen Jedi, including Faris, perfectly preserved in stasis.<ref name="Kenobi IV" />

==Personality and traits==
A member of the [[Theelin]] [[species]], the male Jedi youngling Faris had small horns on either side of his face and spotted, mottled skin.<ref name="Kenobi IV" />

==Behind the scenes==

Dudes! … we are legit Jedis! (Been waiting a year to yell that out)|archivefile=File:Jonathan_and_Oliver_Ho_Instagram_info.png}}</ref>}}
[[File:Youngling_Theelin_make-up.png|thumb|right|180px|The character in full Theelin make-up]]
The Jedi youngling was played by twin martial artists<ref name="Twins">{{WebCite|url=https://www.elitesports.com/pages/team-elite-bjj-fighter-oliver-ho-jonathan-ho|text=Team Elite Bjj Fighter Oliver Ho & Jonathan Ho Elite Sports|quote=Six-year-old Jonathan and Oliver are known as the "Twinjas" due to their love of martial arts and identical twin antics.|archivedate=20220623234055}}</ref> [[Jonathan Ho|Jonathan]] and [[Oliver Ho]] in the TV series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''.<ref name="Kenobi IV" /> The two filmed their part in the summer of [[2021]],<ref name="Instagram summer" /> and got to meet and have scenes with [[Ewan McGregor]] and [[Hayden Christensen]]. The part where [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] finds the remains of their character preserved in stasis in "[[Part IV]]" required wire work.<ref name="Instagram tomb">{{Instagram|username=twinjas_official|url=p/CejD80qOLgD|name=[[Jonathan Ho|Jonathan]] and [[Oliver Ho]]|date=2022-06-08|quote=Small part but gigantic memories and appreciation ❤️. It was so cool 😎 to meet and hang out a little with Ewan and Hayden and have scenes with them. 🤯 Got to do some wire work for the tomb scene in EP4 😃|archivefile=File:Jonathan_and_Oliver_Ho_Instagram_info_2.png}}</ref> Although it does not show very well on-screen, the two wore special make-up to transform their character into a [[Theelin]] with tiny horns and spotted, mottled skin.<ref name="Instagram make-up">{{Instagram|username=twinjas_official|url=p/Ced12uAATVI|name=[[Jonathan Ho|Jonathan]] and [[Oliver Ho]]|date=2022-06-06|quote=Last summer is going to be really tough to top.|archivefile=File:Jonathan_and_Oliver_Ho_Instagram_make-up.png}}</ref>
